blocks.text: Stampede3 jobs are submitted with sbatch. Every batch job must specify an account, partition, node count, and walltime.

Partition | Maximum walltime
spr | 172800 seconds
skx | 172800 seconds
Stampede3 access requires a project allocation. Running jobs consumes that allocation in service units.
Files in Stampede3 scratch that have not been accessed for 10 days are eligible for purge.
